LanguageData.SCP_914CargoArrivedBody: A large transport crate has reached the colony. Select it, assign a colonist, and choose an installation site in an enclosed room. A second colonist will help move and install the machine.
LanguageData.SCP_914InstalledBody: The clockwork machine is in your custody. Study SCP-914 at the Foundation terminal before processing items. The yellow pad on the left is the input; the green pad on the right is the output.
LanguageData.SCP_914LostBody: The transport module was destroyed before installation.
LanguageData.SCP_914InstallDesc: Two colonists will carry the crate and install the machine. An enclosed, roofed room of at least 35 cells and a clear 7 by 4 area are required. The input and output pads must be empty.
LanguageData.SCP_914InstallRoomInvalid: SCP-914 cannot be installed here. Check the room size, roof, clear 7 by 4 area, and colonist access.
LanguageData.SCP_914InstallNoCarrier: No colonist is available to carry the crate.
LanguageData.SCP_914InstallNoAssistant: Installing SCP-914 needs a second available colonist and access to both sides of the machine.
LanguageData.SCP_914InstallInterrupted: SCP-914 installation was interrupted. The crate was left near the colonist; check access and clear space.
LanguageData.SCP_914QuestOffered: The SCP-914 custody assignment is available in the quest list.
LanguageData.SCP_914QuestUnavailable: The SCP-914 assignment is unavailable. Check Foundation contact, the SCP-650 encounter, and whether SCP-914 is already on the map.
